# A1 Air Quality Consultants

> Independent environmental testing and consultation. A1 does not sell remediation or removal services.

## Website
[Website](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/)

## About
A1 Air Quality Consultants is based in Spartanburg, SC. We provide independent testing and consultation for mold, asbestos, lead, radon, and indoor air quality in listed communities across South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, and Tennessee.

## Credentials & Certifications
- SCDES Licensed Building Consultant (South Carolina)
- NCDHHS Licensed Building Inspector (North Carolina)
- AHERA Certified (Asbestos Hazard Emergency Response Act)
- NIOSH 582 Certified (Sampling and Evaluating Airborne Asbestos)
- OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER Trained
- 25+ years of industry experience

## Key Differentiator
A1 provides testing and consultation. If the findings call for cleanup or repairs, the customer can share the report with a separate contractor. The report brings together the building history, observations, and any measurements or laboratory results included in the agreed scope.

- Phone: (864) 619-2092

- Hours: Mon–Fri, 8 AM – 5 PM

Service-area listings describe places the team travels to, not separate offices. Confirm current availability and the scope before booking.

## Resources & Blog Articles

- [**Commercial Indoor Air Quality Testing: Requirements and Best Practices** (Mar 2026)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/commercial-indoor-air-quality-testing-requirements.html)
  How to define a workplace air-quality question, check which project requirements apply, arrange access, and interpret the report.

- [**DIY vs Professional Air Quality Testing** (Mar 2026)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/diy-vs-professional-air-quality-testing.html)
  Compare what a home monitor, radon kit, or professional assessment can measure. Check what a quote includes and what a property transaction requires.

- [**How Much Does Air Quality Testing Cost?** (Mar 2026)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/how-much-does-air-quality-testing-cost.html)
  How inspection scope, sample count, laboratory methods, property location, and reporting affect a quote. Contact A1 for current pricing.

- [**Why Independent Testing Matters** (Mar 2026)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/why-independent-testing-matters.html)
  Questions for comparing testing and cleanup proposals, including who interprets the results and who would perform any recommended work.

- [**Indoor Air Quality: How It Affects Health and Productivity** (Mar 2026)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/indoor-air-quality-health-and-productivity.html)
  How indoor pollutants can affect health, what productivity research measures, and when targeted testing may help answer a building-specific question.

- [**Lead Paint Testing: What Every Homeowner Should Know** (Feb 2026)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/lead-paint-testing-what-homeowners-should-know.html)
  The differences between a lead paint inspection, a risk assessment, and a targeted sample, and what to confirm before booking.

- [**Understanding Radon: The Silent Health Risk** (Feb 2026)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/understanding-radon-silent-health-risk.html)
  Radon is a radioactive gas and the #2 cause of lung cancer in the U.S. Covers how it enters homes, EPA action levels, and testing methods.

- [**What Is Asbestos? Risks, Types, and Why Testing Matters** (Jan 2026)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/what-is-asbestos-why-test-before-renovating.html)
  Asbestos is a group of mineral fibers used in construction before the 1980s. Covers where it hides, health risks, and NESHAP/OSHA requirements.

- [**Signs You May Need Mold Testing** (Jan 2026)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/signs-you-may-need-mold-testing.html)
  How to follow up on musty odors, water damage, or recurring dampness and decide whether a sample would answer a specific question.

- [**Do I Need Radon Testing Before Buying a Home?** (Dec 2025)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/do-i-need-radon-testing-before-buying-a-home.html)
  How to evaluate an existing radon report and plan access, monitoring, and time to review results before a purchase deadline.

- [**VOC Testing: What Are Volatile Organic Compounds?** (Nov 2025)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/voc-testing-volatile-organic-compounds.html)
  Sources of volatile organic compounds, how testing methods differ, and what a total-VOC reading can tell you about a particular space.

- [**Home Inspection Checklist: Mold, Asbestos, Lead, and Radon** (Nov 2025)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/home-inspection-checklist-mold-asbestos-lead-radon.html)
  A printable checklist for planning asbestos, mold, lead, radon, and other indoor-air questions before a purchase or renovation.

- [**Radon Levels in SC, NC, GA, and TN** (Oct 2025)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/radon-levels-in-north-carolina-south-carolina-georgia.html)
  Explains the limits of regional radon maps and how to plan property testing in South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, and Tennessee.

- [**What Humidity Level Causes Mold?** (Sep 2025)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/what-humidity-level-causes-mold.html)
  How to use EPA humidity targets, spot condensation, and check damp materials. A room humidity reading alone cannot establish whether mold is present.

- [**Lead Paint Dangers in Pre-1978 Homes** (Sep 2025)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/lead-paint-dangers-in-pre-1978-homes.html)
  How the condition of older painted surfaces and the work planned for them inform a lead-testing discussion before renovation.

- [**Asbestos Inspections Before Renovation in South Carolina** (Aug 2025)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/do-i-need-asbestos-testing-before-renovation.html)
  Inspection requirements depend on building type, project scope, and jurisdiction. Links to EPA and state programs, with guidance on planning an inspection before disturbing suspect materials.

- [**How Long Does Mold Take to Grow After Water Damage?** (Jul 2025)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/how-long-does-mold-take-to-grow-after-water-damage.html)
  Why EPA recommends drying wet materials within 24 to 48 hours where feasible, and how the material and moisture conditions affect mold growth.

- [**Hiring a Home Air Quality Tester When You Need Laboratory Analysis**](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/home-air-quality-testing-near-me-with-laboratory-analysis.html)
  Compare sample targets, rooms, laboratory methods and written reports before booking.
- [**What Is Indoor Air Quality Testing? A Complete Guide** (Jul 2025)](https://a1airqualityconsultants.com/blog/what-is-indoor-air-quality-testing.html)
  How building history, site observations, and selected measurements guide an indoor-air investigation, and which questions its report can answer.
